thread:
Ravi (release-lead): quick check before the quiet-window flip for py/ts SDKs at 03:00 UTC. publish-bot scheduled. can we run final npm/pypi integrity checks?
megan: running npm shasum verify + tarball inspect for the TS package now.
publish-bot: scheduled publish job queued for 2026-03-23T03:00:00Z (can be cancelled with `--hold`).
Olga (pkg): I see a mismatch: the tarball on npm registry shows shasum `d41d8cd9` that doesn't match our build artifact which is `7f3a9b2c`.
megan: same here locally. `npm pack` produced `7f3a9b2c`, but registry returns `d41d...`. Checksums differ but sizes match.
Liam (QA): there's also a quick smoke failing in Node 18 for stream backpressure test, could be unrelated but flagging it.
Ravi (release-lead): HOLD the publish. Do not flip dist tag. Olga, can you republish from CI artifact storage and force the shasum header? Also create a canary plan if republish fixes it.
Olga (pkg): replaying publish from CI store now: `npm publish --registry https://registry.internal --tag next --from-artifact build/ts/3.1.0.tgz`. Will include `--shasum 7f3a9b2c` override and invalidate CDN.
publish-bot: publish job status updated: HELD by @Ravi at 2026-03-23T02:16:00Z :white_check_mark:
CI-bot: triggered integrity-check job `ci/integrity-npm #8102`.
megan: integrity job output:
```
fetched tarball shasum: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e
expected (build cache): 7f3a9b2c5e2f...
note: tarball content diff shows missing "dist/*.map" files on registry copy
```
Olga (pkg): aha. CDN/packager earlier stripped sourcemaps during mirroring. republish will include them. pushing republish now + CDN purge.
Liam (QA): once republished I'll rerun Node18 backpressure test and the compatibility suite.
CI-bot: republish job started `ci/republish-npm #8103` and cdn purge queued.
Olga (pkg): repush complete, CDN invalidated. Registry now shows shasum 7f3a9b2c.
CI-bot: integrity job PASSED: shasums match, tarball contents verified.
Liam (QA): running e2e: Node 18 test still shows sporadic failure (timeout in stream test). Investigating stack trace.
megan: could be unrelated (we've seen flakiness on that test in last week). suggest a 5% canary first, 10m window, watch client telemetry and npm download anomalies.
Ravi (release-lead): ok: plan A: 5% canary for 10m on `--tag next` with `--signed-only` semantics for pypi and `--shasum-verified` for npm; plan B (if Node18 e2e fails consistently): revert npm dist-tag and escalate. DeployBot, run canary: `publish --tag next --canary 5% --shasum-verified --meta "ts-sdk quiet-window canary"`. Hold final flip until we confirm metrics.
DeployBot: command queued by @Ravi: `publish --tag next --canary 5% --shasum-verified --meta "ts-sdk quiet-window canary"` 1 starting canary.
megan: watching downloads, telemetry, error rate threshold 1.5%. alert -> this thread.
CI-bot: canary smoke job `ci/canary-e2e #8104` triggered for a sampled subset.
(6 minutes)
CI-bot: canary e2e results: 95/100 passed, 5 failures all in Node18 stream test. error rate reported to DeployBot: 5%.
Liam (QA): reproducer looks like a race in local stream buffer when chunked POSTs hit proxied dev environment. Could be infra timing change in edge node. We have a quick mitigation: increase client retry-window in the TS SDK canary clients to add a 100ms jitter. Not ideal but buys time.
Olga (pkg): I don't want to ship a band-aid. Recommend revert canary, open a blocker, and fix upstream with a proper patch.
Ravi (release-lead): agree. Revert canary now. We'll not promote to latest. Create rollback announcement and stop release notes publish until root-cause is fixed.
DeployBot: executing revert: `dist-tag revert next -> previous` 1 canary reverted.
publish-bot: canary reverted, registry tags restored.
megan: created a short rollback message for #release-notes and scheduled a follow-up update once the fix is in: "Canary reverted due to Node18 stream flakiness; investigating; no GA push."
Liam (QA): filing RDX-4502 with stack traces and a minimal repro. Assigning to infra + runtime.
Olga (pkg): also created RDX-4503 for CDN packaging check to ensure sourcemaps aren't stripped in future replications.
Ravi (release-lead): next steps: 1) QA+Infra to triage RDX-4502 (24h SLA). 2) pkg to add a registry integrity gate that fails publish if tarball content differs from build-cache. 3) Docs to mark release notes as draft until resolved. 4) If fix is available within 24h, we'll re-run preflight and schedule a smaller quiet-window retry; otherwise, schedule next-week roll.
megan: added `npm-registry-integrity` gate to the publish pipeline draft (PR opened).
Olga (pkg): will also add a `--verify-contents` flag to our publish tooling (PR queued).
Ravi (release-lead): thanks all. Keeping this thread as the decision record. When RDX-4502 is resolved we'll reconvene here for go/no-go. :white_check_mark:
